messages:
Alex Nguyen: Quick heads-up — thinking about a compact community push: 3 short tutorials (30–45m read/vid), an OSS reference app repo, and a single launch webinar to stitch it together. Primary goals: dev signups, contributor leads, and a steady stream of feedback for the refapp. Draft brief: https://docs.google.com/example :rocket:
Priya Shah: love it. timeline? we should avoid clashing with the infra release on 7/14. maybe target the webinar for the week after so we can show the GA refapp build.
Tom Baker: I can own webinar logistics (platform, registration, recording). Wed 7/21 10am PT works for me. Will confirm with ops and block calendar.
Olivia Chen: I'll take social + email. Need 2 weeks lead time for cadence: teaser, registration open, reminder, last-chance. Also want 1 community thread on Discourse + a short demo video.
Samir Patel: For inbound routing — recommended flow: landing page -> registration form (collect: name, org, role, use-case, team size) -> Zapier -> SFDC lead + tag "refapp-launch-2025". Also add UTM params: utm_source=community, utm_campaign=refapp_launch, utm_medium=social.
Alex Nguyen: @Priya can you confirm content timeline? @Olivia for social copy do you want rough lines now?
Priya Shah: Timeline proposal in the doc: tutorials drafted by 7/7, review by 7/10, refapp repo ready w/ readme and quickstart by 7/14, webinar 7/21. That gives 1 week of promo.
Olivia Chen: I'll draft 3 short social posts + 1 announcement email. Quick sample tweet for feedback:
```
New: Hands-on refapp + tutorial series from Redwood Inference — ship LLM features faster. Join our launch webinar 7/21 to see a live demo + quickstart. Register: https://redwood.ai/refapp?utm_source=community&utm_campaign=refapp_launch
```
Samir Patel: Add a CTA in email to "Get the refapp" that goes to a gated download (email + company) so we can route hot leads to AE queue. Also set lead score = event_attended + repo_star + demo_request.
Tom Baker: Ops note: record webinar, auto-post to YouTube and embed in refapp README afterward. I’ll enable closed captions.
Alex Nguyen: Content needs: 3 tutorial outlines (intro, advanced, production checklist), 1 quickstart README, 1 demo deck, social/email copy, landing page + form, webinar slides + script. Assigning: Priya outlines + demo deck, Olivia social + email, Samir routing + landing page, Tom webinar infra, Alex to review and approve.
marketing-bot: Created checklist ticket #MKT-8321 and calendar event. Tasks: tutorials draft, repo PR, landing page, webinar booking, promo assets.
Priya Shah: For the OSS release note — keep tone developer-first, include performance notes (latency benchmarks, cost comparisons) and a short migration guide. I’ll draft and ping @Alex for numbers.
Olivia Chen: We should also prepare 2 short clips (30–60s) for X/TikTok with demo snippets. Will storyboard after drafts.
Samir Patel: Quick mapping for routing: registrant -> lead in SFDC with tag -> if attended -> mark as MQL and notify AE channel (#sales). Can create a zap that posts to Slack #sales-leads.
Alex Nguyen: Nice. Can we also add a small feedback form post-webinar that asks for eval datasets/use-cases? We want structured feedback.
Priya Shah: Yep. I'll include a form link in the follow-up email and in the YouTube description.
Olivia Chen: Draft timeline posted in the doc. I'll share first round of copy by EOD Friday.
Tom Baker: I'll confirm webinar platform and recording test by Monday.
Samir Patel: Will draft Zap <> SFDC mapping and share field list by Monday.
Alex Nguyen: Awesome — momentum. Let's reconvene Tue for a quick sync if drafts are in. Thanks everyone :tada:
